core_obligations: Set up the induction on the length of the filtration of the given bounded filtered complex (proof lines 15660-15680).
Resolve the lowest graded piece at each stage and lift the maps along the filtration to obtain a new filtered complex (proof lines 15680-15730).
Compare the cohomology of the new complex with that of the previous stage by the long exact sequence, preserving the quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 15730-15760).
Conclude that the system constructed resolves the original complex with the boundedness properties asserted (proof lines 15760-15764).

difficulty_reason: The lemma resolves a bounded filtered complex by a system of filtered complexes with prescribed properties, and the proof is a 105-line construction organised as an induction on the length of the filtration. At each stage it resolves the lowest graded piece, lifts the resolution along the filtration, and compares the cohomology of the new complex with the previous one by the long exact sequence of a short exact sequence of complexes. The two steps that carry the content are the lifting of the resolution along the filtration and the cohomology comparison, and both are written out rather than cited.
